name: Ocean's End
source:
You are a lone soul in a tiny boat stranded in the middle of the ocean. Depending on your choice, you can explore the different ways to, well, die - with hunger, blood... maybe even drown yourself in an endless cycle of despair. A visual novel with multiple endings, inspired from a Russian VN titled "Disturbed".

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/oceans-end]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
你是一艘搁浅在大海中央的小船里孤独的灵魂。根据你的选择，你可以探索不同的死亡方式——饥饿、鲜血……甚至可能让自己陷入无尽的绝望循环。一部具有多个结局的视觉小说，灵感来自俄罗斯VN，名为“Disturbed”。

[来自[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/oceans-end]Global Game Jam[/url]]

为2017年Global Game Jam创建。
